**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

The Agreement contains no take-or-pay exposure for Clear Capital. Work is engaged task-by-task under Statements of Work, compensation is time-and-materials only, and termination triggers payment solely for fees already incurred or earned — an incurred-cost true-up rather than a shortfall penalty. This meets our preferred position, so I proposed no changes.

One adjacent item I noted for the record but did not flag under this rule: §6(a) allows convenience termination only when no uncompleted Statement of Work is outstanding. That is an exit/term issue rather than a minimum purchase commitment, and it would be better addressed under whichever playbook rule governs termination rights.
